module TopModule (
    input a,
    input b,
    input c,
    input d,
    output reg q
);
    always @(*) begin
        q = a & b & ~c & d | a & b & c & ~d | ~a & b & c & d | ~a & b & ~c & ~d;
    end
endmodule

module TopModule (

    always @(*) begin
        q = (a & ~b & ~c & ~d) | (a & ~b & ~c & d) | (a & ~b & c & ~d) | (a & ~b & c & d) | (a & b & ~c & ~d) | (a & b & ~c & d) | (a & b & c & ~d) | (a & b & c & d);
    end
endmodule

module TopModule (
